Alerts you when a guarded tag moves
Moved %1$d m. Tap to see the map.
Find Hub shows only your tag\'s last spot. This app saves the full history and alerts you if it moves. New here? Read the quick guide first – it explains everything.

Google needs TWO things, both on Google\'s own pages (the app never sees your password or PIN): your account sign-in, and a one-time screen-lock check that releases the keys to DECRYPT your tag locations. Google requires that second check for end-to-end encryption – no app can skip it. Tap the one button below and just follow the prompts; it walks you through both and you won\'t need to repeat it. Updating the app later does NOT log you out.
Prefer to do the two steps yourself? The individual buttons are below.
⚠ You\'re signed in and your tags are listed, but the map will stay empty until you finish step 2. Tap “Unlock encryption keys” and enter your phone\'s screen lock.
✓ All set – the app can read and decrypt your tags.

Option B: If the steps above fail, run the desktop setup once on a PC (python -m server.manage google-login), copy the resulting data/google_secrets.json to this phone, and import it here. No re-login needed on the phone.

The app checks Find Hub in the background with Android WorkManager (Google\'s battery-efficient scheduler) and saves every location. It uses almost no battery while idle: it only wakes for a few seconds per check, needs a network connection, and closes the connection in between. It uses NO device-location permission (locations come from Google\'s network, not your phone\'s GPS). Android\'s minimum interval is 15 minutes; pick a longer one to use even less battery.
Longer interval = less battery. 240 min is the battery-saver option. See exactly what the app does and its tiny active time in Battery & activity:
Optional: only if your phone (Xiaomi/Samsung/etc.) aggressively kills background apps, allow unrestricted running so checks aren\'t skipped. Not required on most phones.
✓ A status notification shows while the app runs in the background.
Closing the app (swiping it away) does NOT stop tracking – it keeps checking and saving in the background, which is what you want. Use the button below only when you want to FULLY stop it.
⏸ Background tracking is STOPPED. No locations are being saved.

Your locations are ALWAYS saved on the phone first – they can never be lost, even with no internet or if Drive is busy. Google Drive is an extra cloud copy on top. Choose:\n• CONTINUOUS SYNC (recommended): phone + Google Drive, syncs after each check. If offline or rate-limited, it just retries later – nothing is lost.\n• LOCAL ONLY: keep everything on the phone, no cloud (turn both options below off).
✓ DEFAULT automatic sync is ON (folder ‘TagTracker’ in your Google account).
DEFAULT: automatic sync to a ‘TagTracker’ folder in your own Google account – no file picking, and it comes back automatically when you sign in on another phone.
— or use a CUSTOM file (any account / location) —\nIn the picker, tap ☰ and choose GOOGLE DRIVE (not phone storage), pick a folder, and name it e.g. TagTracker-history.csv.
Restore history from a Drive file

Turn this ON when the bike is parked. If a tag MOVES more than ~150 m, you get a LOUD notification with a Maps link – so you can act fast if it\'s stolen. Uses the same background checks, so no extra battery. Tip: if it\'s stolen, share the live location and history with the police – don\'t confront the thief yourself.
✓ Guard mode is ON – you\'ll be alerted if a tag moves.

Protect the app with a password so no one who picks up your phone can open your tracker. The password and hint are stored ONLY on this phone – never sent to Google or Drive, so they can\'t be recovered from anywhere else. If you forget it and the hint doesn\'t help, reinstall the app.

Not affiliated with Google. This app uses an UNOFFICIAL method to read the Find network – Google may block it at any time, and it may violate Google\'s Terms of Service. For tracking YOUR OWN property only, never a person without consent. Your data stays on your phone and your own Google Drive; nothing is sent to the developer. Provided AS IS, no warranty. Open-source (GPL-3.0), built on GoogleFindMyTools.

Tag Tracker is built to sip battery:
• It uses NO GPS and NO location permission (positions come from Google's network).
• It wakes only briefly every %1$d minutes, then sleeps.
• It closes its network connection between checks.
• Android (WorkManager) batches the checks at efficient moments.
